name: Full Application Capability Audit Lane

scope.target: full application capability, not frozen demo path only

categories.label: Route Inventory
categories.requiredNextProof: Every router path must be visited with auth posture, render status, console errors, and data dependencies recorded.

categories.label: API Inventory
categories.requiredNextProof: Build a full endpoint contract matrix for every HTTP method attribute and classify live/protected/broken/dead/not-applicable.

categories.label: Module Inventory
categories.requiredNextProof: Each suite/module needs task proof: load, real data, action, result, error handling, and exit path.

categories.label: Data Provenance Audit
categories.requiredNextProof: Map every user-facing screen to dev39 Postgres, production DB, mock JSON, hardcoded fixtures, local storage, or unknown.

categories.label: Rust Engine Audit
categories.requiredNextProof: Compile and trace live calls into each claimed Rust engine before any runtime claim.

categories.label: Redis Audit
categories.requiredNextProof: Prove configured Redis endpoint, cache hits/misses, failure behavior, and whether runtime depends on it.

categories.label: Prometheus / Observability Audit
categories.requiredNextProof: Verify metrics emission, scrapeability, dashboards, alerting, and correlationId traceability for live failures.

categories.label: CLI / Operator Tooling Audit

evidence.knownPackageScripts: not fully audited by this lane

categories.requiredNextProof: Inventory CLI/operator tools, run each supported command, and mark dead/internal/launch-critical.

categories.label: UX / Workflow Audit
categories.requiredNextProof: Run real user tasks: login, find parcel, open TerraForge, execute workflow, export/view evidence, logout.

categories.label: Mock / Stub Audit
categories.requiredNextProof: Classify every mock/stub/demo/sample/placeholder as production-excluded, test-only, dead, or active blocker.

nextExecutionSlices: Build endpoint contract matrix for all backend HTTP method attributes.
Build route-to-workflow matrix for every frontend router path.
Classify mock/stub/demo/sample/placeholder references into active blocker vs test-only.
Map each user-facing data dependency to Postgres, API, local storage, fixture, or unknown.
Run Rust, Redis, Prometheus, and CLI runtime proof lanes separately.
hardStop: Do not claim full production readiness until every category is PROVEN or explicitly not applicable with evidence.
